#!/bin/bash

# Script to apply system configuration commands from system_config.txt
# Usage: ./apply_config.sh

CONFIG_FILE="/workspace/system_config.txt"

# Check if the config file exists
if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: Configuration file not found at $CONFIG_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Reading and executing commands from $CONFIG_FILE..."
echo "=================================================="

# Read and execute each line from the config file
while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    if [ -z "$line" ] || [[ "$line" =~ ^# ]]; then
        continue
    fi

    eval "$line"

    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✓ Command succeeded"

        echo "✗ Command failed"
    fi
    echo "---"
done < "$CONFIG_FILE"

echo "=================================================="
echo "Configuration application complete."
